project.name: HS: Heist
project.summary: A first-person heist where the human and a required WebMCP agent share two infiltrators, switch bodies, survive a bomb breach and authored chase, then turn real failures into inspectable evidence-backed partner memory.
project.ai_usage: OpenAI Codex was the primary builder. Raw Cursor CLI with Claude Opus 5 High and Grok 4.6 High was used for bounded visual passes; Cursor MCP was not used.
project.codex_usage: Codex led product shaping, current-doc research, architecture, implementation, integration, debugging, automated browser verification, strict code-quality review, and release documentation.
